title: The world has been severely compressed
text:
The world has been severely compressed. Ordered this tapestry because we wanted a world map for our living room.

The entire image they used has been squished width-wise and overly stretched length-wise to preposterous proportions. They should have rotated the image to fit it properly onto the tapestry but instead they scaled the image too narrow horizontally to fit and possibly stretched it out vertically - in the process they destroyed all continents and made much of the labels unreadable and pixellated.

The only nice thing I can say is that the tapestry material was thick and satiny with edges folded over for good border support. The fact that they distorted the map this way is what makes it useless.
